subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability output keep the documented provider-before-basic-cleanup fallback order, even though this can invoke configured providers for pages that previously returned local title-only output?
rationale: The code is a plausible bug fix, but fallback ordering affects compatibility, latency, and provider cost for existing installations, so automation should not choose that tradeoff.

options.title: Accept provider-first recovery
options.body: Merge with the current order because it extends the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence to title-only Readability output.

options.title: Switch title-only local-first
options.body: Ask for title-only pages to try body-scoped local cleanup before external provider fallback to minimize provider calls and latency.

options.title: Ask for exact-page proof
options.body: Hold merge until someone can provide a live or saved failing page that proves this representative invariant matches the original report.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-first recovery
recommendation.body: Merge with the current order because it extends the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence to title-only Readability output.
